intro: Iron Pikes are sturdy construction materials originally shipped from Stormwind to aid in repairing the Everstill Bridge in Lakeshire. The shipment was ambushed and looted by Redridge gnolls, leaving the town short on essential rebuilding supplies.

p: When Lakeshire faced recent attacks from the Blackrock orcs, the town's metal reserves were melted down to forge armor, blades, and ammunition for defense. In response to the shortage, local builders requested a resupply shipment of iron from Stormwind City. Before the materials could reach the town, a pack of Redridge gnolls hijacked the transport caravan along the road. The gnolls dragged crates of iron pikes and rivets north into the hills, halting critical repairs on the Everstill Bridge.

Foreman Oslow, charged with overseeing the reconstruction of the Everstill Bridge, relies on adventurers to enter gnoll territory and reclaim the pilfered hardware. Without these heavy iron pikes to reinforce the stone and timber framework, Lakeshire remains partially severed from the northern roadway and vulnerable to further incursions.
